## SEO & Publishing Notes
- The portfolio is deployed on Vercel; static files placed in the repository root will be available at `https://<project>.vercel.app/<path>` once deployment completes.
- For search engines:
  - Add internal links from the homepage to important assets (e.g., `exploder/llms-full.txt`) so crawlers can discover them.
  - Create and publish `sitemap.xml` listing primary URLs and submit in Google Search Console.
  - Avoid `robots.txt` rules that block crawlers from these paths.
